subject: The new website
body:
I saw the site. Very nice. I looked at it three times already.

One favor, only if you have time. You are on Y, yes? If you write something about the new site, maybe some people see it and come eat. I don't know how Y works. My nephew did all of that.

If not, no problem. You did plenty.

Gino

outcomes.when: the player says they will post about the restaurant or its new website on Y, or already did
outcomes.reply: Grazie! I will look for it.

outcomes.when: the player says no, says they don't use Y, or says they don't have time to post
outcomes.reply: No problem at all. The food will do the marketing.
